slot.brief: Give formulae of 2–3 complexes; ask which pair exhibits ionisation/hydrate/linkage isomerism

stem: Which pair of complexes exhibits ionisation isomerism?

verdicts.working: Ionisation isomers interchange a coordinated anion and a counter-ion. In (A), coordinated Cl⁻ and external NO₂⁻ swap places.

working:
A: $\text{Cl}^-$ and $\text{NO}_2^-$ interchange between the coordination sphere and counterion position.
B: Hydrate isomers.
C: Linkage isomers.
D: Coordination isomers.

Independent check: Ionisation isomers interchange a coordinated anion and a counter-ion. In (A), coordinated Cl⁻ and external NO₂⁻ swap places.
solution: Ionisation isomers differ by interchange of an anion inside the coordination sphere with a counter-ion outside it. In (C), coordinated $\text{Cl}^-$ and external $\text{NO}_2^-$ exchange positions: $[\text{Co(NH}_3)_5\text{Cl}]\text{NO}_2 \rightleftharpoons [\text{Co(NH}_3)_5\text{NO}_2]\text{Cl}$. Thus, the pair in (C) exhibits ionisation isomerism.
